knowledge_gaps: The comparisons cannot isolate the distinct-source gate: include an ungated directed-transition control before attributing improvements to repeated support. Objective-only SASRec remains a credible winner.

Source reliability n[a]/(n[a]+tau) does not measure reliability of edge a→b. Rare destinations can receive clipped positive lift from singleton edges, and two distinct sources need not constitute independent evidence.

Training transition counts include the edges being predicted. This is permitted training-data fitting, but can inflate training support and margins; prefix-masking diagnostics cannot detect this shortcut.

The fixed TF–IDF comparison is underspecified: replacing learned text vectors requires explicit pooling, normalization, amplitude calibration, and artifact definitions. Its scale must be comparable with the directed residual.

Sparse lookup, full-catalog scoring, per-category budget allocation, and the packed-feature contract remain unspecified. Packing integer item IDs into floating-point features requires explicit dtype and precision handling.

Originality 4 is defensible as a provisional assessment. Future potential 7 lacks coverage evidence, and code difficulty 4 may underestimate efficient causal scoring and predictor integration. Validation uncertainty and adaptive selection limitations should also be reported.
